ai.base_hint: Use the API base address, usually ending in /v1; omit /chat/completions.
ai.cancelled: Stopped. Any response received is preserved above.
ai.clear_confirm: Starting a new conversation clears this chat. Your draft stays in the input.

ai.connect_body: Configure your model in Settings, then ask a question here.
ai.data_scope_detail: The model receives your conversation and runtime summaries. On demand, it can read DNS results, app/domain connections with matched rules and outbound chains, sanitized recent logs, TUN/helper state, and saved bypass/PAC/guard preferences. Full configurations and credentials are excluded. Limits: 20 logs, 20 connections, 6 node probes per turn. Node, mode, Merge, DNS, system proxy and TUN changes require your confirmation.
ai.dns_impact: Save global DNS settings and reload the core. Resolution may pause briefly; failures attempt to restore the previous configuration.
ai.empty: Configure a provider, then ask: Why is my network not working?
ai.error_api_address: This address returned a web page. Use the provider's API base address, usually with /v1 after the domain.
ai.error_auth: Authentication failed. Check the API key in provider settings.
ai.error_config: Provider settings are invalid. Check the address, model and advanced settings.
ai.error_disconnected: The connection closed before the response completed. Check the service and proxy, then retry.
ai.error_dns: Could not resolve the service or proxy hostname. Check the address and DNS settings.
ai.error_generic: Request failed. Retry, or check provider settings if it persists.
ai.error_key: Check the API key. When changing the service address, enter a new key or clear the old one.
ai.error_limit: This conversation reached its limit. Start a new conversation.
ai.error_model: Endpoint or model not found. Check the service address and model name.
ai.error_network: Could not connect to the service. Check your network, proxy and service address, then retry.
ai.error_quota: Rate or quota limit reached. Retry later or check your provider quota.
ai.error_refused: The service or proxy refused the connection. Check its address and port, and make sure it is running.
ai.error_stream_format: The service did not return a stream. Check that the address and model support streaming Chat Completions.
ai.error_timeout: The service did not respond in time. Check your network and proxy, or increase the timeout in advanced settings.
ai.error_tls: Could not establish a secure connection. Check the service certificate, system time and proxy.
ai.evidence_unavailable: This information is unavailable; no conclusion can be drawn from it.
ai.key_keep_hint: Saved. Leave blank to keep the current key.
ai.key_optional: Leave blank for local services without authentication.
ai.key_will_clear: The key will be removed when you save.
ai.keyboard: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
ai.merge_impact: Changes global Merge for all profiles and reloads the core, which may interrupt connections. Failure attempts to restore the previous configuration and runtime choices.
ai.no_answer: No response received. You can retry this question.
ai.no_matching_logs: No matching logs in the recent buffer
ai.not_checked: Mihomo validation has not run for this turn
ai.privacy_short: Questions and summaries go to your model. Tests probe up to 6 nodes; setting changes require separate confirmation.
ai.provider_body: Use an OpenAI-compatible service. The API key is saved in local app settings.
ai.proxy_apply_now: Apply to the current system proxy and save preferences
ai.proxy_impact: Use saved proxy settings and remember startup intent. Disabling restores prior network service settings; failed recovery retains its recovery record.
ai.proxy_save_only: Save for the next enable; keep the system proxy off
ai.proxy_settings_impact: Bypass applies to manual system proxy. PAC uses the saved script; TUN rules stay unchanged. The proxy enable state is preserved; failures attempt to restore prior settings.
ai.readonly: Diagnostics and proposals · changes need confirmation
ai.recovery_failed: Application and recovery failed. Check the core and current configuration.
ai.runtime_impact: Changes the current mode or selected node. Failure attempts to restore the original value; existing connections may retain their outbound.
